title.narrative: Water & Sanitation for improved health outcomes in Odisha

description.narrative: This activity Water & Sanitation for improved health outcomes in Odisha is a component of DFID support to Water, Sanitation and Hygiene Programme for Madhya Pradesh & Odisha reported by FCDO with a funding type of 104 - Procurement of Services and a budget of £10,397,396. It works in the following sector(s): Basic sanitation, Basic drinking water supply.
